name: fishaudio
description: Fish Audio text-to-speech backend for Hermes. Registers a 'fishaudio' TTS provider (s2.1-pro-free by default) that strips fenced/inline code and markdown before synthesis so technical replies are not read verbatim, synthesizes sentence-by-sentence for low latency, retries rate limits and server errors with backoff, and caches responses for 24 hours. Exposes voice/model catalogs and opts into voice-bubble delivery (Opus) on Telegram.
author: Jon David Cho Chiles
